{
  "winner": "A",
  "reasons": [
    "A's demand evidence shows people already paying. All four quotes cite real amounts ($20/mo Pingdom, $8→$34/mo UptimeRobot, a $79 BetterUptime invoice) and an intent to switch. B's Reddit quotes show that writing descriptions is tedious, but none shows willingness to pay.",
    "B faces a free, built-in substitute. Shopify Magic generates descriptions at no extra cost for every paid-plan merchant, which undercuts B's stated target segment. A's brief names no comparable free native replacement.",
    "B's retention risk is structural. The brief says the need may be one-time per catalog. A's monitoring need is ongoing, and the quotes show users paying monthly.",
    "A has a sourced, $0-cash acquisition precedent: Product Hunt drove Instatus's first customer wave (559 upvotes, Product of the Day), and SEO growth is documented. B's paid-channel evidence is one developer's CPI anecdote, and its organic channel is described as hard to rank in without reviews.",
    "B's competitor traction signals are mostly weak. Descrii has 0 reviews, Gelo.ai has 3, and Describly has a single 1-star review. That points to a discovery bottleneck in the description segment. A's competitors show some sourced pricing and reported traction (Instatus ~$40K MRR / ~1000 customers, though that figure is 'reported')."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "B's ADA urgency claim ($25,000-$75,000 settlements; 77% of ADA lawsuits target online stores) comes from accessibility and app-marketing content sites, not court or legal data. It is the main reason given for the alt-text half of the idea. The Reddit demand quotes are also weak: they show the task is unpleasant, not that merchants will pay a subscription when Shopify Magic is free.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate. A has serious weaknesses: extreme saturation (10+ near-identical clones racing to $9/mo), a costly reliability burden for one operator, and an unsourced Hyperping ~$15K MRR figure, which I treated as missing. B has one structural advantage the briefs underweight: the Shopify App Store bundles billing and distribution. AltText.ai's 141 reviews also suggest paid alt-text demand exists, so a narrow alt-text-only B could be competitive. On the evidence as written, A's demonstrated willingness to pay and lack of a free native substitute give it the edge for a first paying customer within 90 days."
}
